wheel.en: Can I? Can I get behind the wheel? Don't be silly!
wheel.zh: 可以吗？我能去坐驾驶位吗？别闹了！

whole.en: The whole shebang . And it's a similar change of mood in the US, in Japan, the world over.
whole.zh: 全套都算上了。在美国、在日本、在全世界，氛围都发生了类似的变化。

whatever.en: Grid engineers call this baseload power : a steady, reliable supply that is always there, whatever the weather.
whatever.zh: 电网工程师称之为“基荷电力”：一种无论天气如何，始终稳定、可靠的供应。
